en: Black‑and‑white street scene of a European town with cobblestone pavement and rows of 2–3 story gabled houses. Shopfronts on the ground floor bear German‑language signs, including a corner building labelled "Rudolph Wöhler" and another business with a sign for "Gertrud Zschaler, Milch‑Tafel‑Margarin". A woman with a parasol stands near the shop entrance with children seated outside, and a man rides a bicycle on the street. Architectural style suggests an older German town center with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings.
